plugins.description: UI plugin package entry for profile badge styling.

info.title: Profile Badges Plus
info.what: Adds ACTIVE/FAVORITE/CORE badges to profile items for faster scanning.
info.how: When enabled, profile list cards are re-rendered with badge chips based on profile state.
info.usage: Enable in Plugin Manager and open Profiles list to see badge chips.
